docstring:
Parse a GitHub URL to extract owner and repo name.

Handles http/https prefixes, www prefixes, and .git extensions.
Returns None if the target is not a valid GitHub repository URL.

Args:
    url: GitHub URL string to parse.

Returns:
    Tuple of (owner, repo) or None if invalid.
ref_test:
def test_parse_github_url():
    assert parse_github_url('https://github.com/torvalds/linux') == ('torvalds', 'linux')
    assert parse_github_url('https://www.github.com/psf/black.git') == ('psf', 'black')
    assert parse_github_url('github.com/pallets/flask') == ('pallets', 'flask')
    assert parse_github_url('https://gitlab.com/owner/repo') is None
    assert parse_github_url('not a url') is None
    assert parse_github_url('') is None

test_parse_github_url()
